selection_basis: Visible pale wall/fence plane independently marked from source pixels; excludes road and sidewalk below. Same polygon as prior candidate. High confirmation revision frozen before candidate replay and extra Newport36 recheck. No IDs, timestamps, class restriction, or stationarity criterion.
purpose: Experimental camera-specific multi-resolution confirmation of detections centered over reviewed background; not an unconditional image mask or proof of false positives.
limitations: Unconfirmed detections can still be real vehicles occluding the wall.
Same model at two sizes provides correlated evidence, not an independent verifier.
No automatic deployment to other cameras or all115videos.
revision_basis: One explicit revision after .10 secondary evidence confirmed a known wall false positive through a .10189 score. Use previously selected .35 validation detection/new-track threshold for positive secondary confirmation. No changes to .10 tracking input, polygon, or IoU; not a fresh independent validation.
